q22890.en: When approaching a junction, you must get ready to follow the right-of-way rules.

explain.short: Near a junction other vehicles may have priority, so you must be ready to slow down and give way.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'predisporsi' means 'get ready': you prepare before you arrive, not at the last moment.

sceneParams.caption: Near a junction, be ready to give way

q22891.en: When approaching a junction, you must move in time into the lane for the direction you want to take.

explain.short: If you change lane at the last moment you cut across other cars. Move to the right lane early, after checking the mirrors.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'per tempo' means 'in time / in advance', not at the last second.

sceneParams.caption: Choose your lane early before the junction

q22892.en: When approaching a junction, you must signal in time your intention to turn.

explain.short: Others must know early what you will do. Switch on the indicator in advance, not while you are already turning.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'per tempo' means 'in advance': a last-moment signal is not enough.

lines: Junction ahead: you want to turn
sceneParams.caption: Indicator on in good time before turning

q22893.en: When riding a two-wheeled vehicle near a junction, you must queue behind the other waiting vehicles.

explain.short: A motorbike or bicycle must not slip between the waiting cars to reach the front. It waits in the queue like everyone else.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'incolonnarsi' means 'to join the queue', not to pass the queue.

sceneParams.caption: On two wheels: wait in the queue at junctions

q22894.en: When arriving at a junction, you may enter it only if you are able to continue and clear it.

explain.short: If you enter and get stuck in the middle, you block the cross traffic. Wait until there is space on the other side.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'liberarlo' means 'to clear it': you must be able to get out the other side.

lines: Go when you can clear it
sceneParams.caption: Enter the junction only if you can get out

q22895.en: When approaching a junction, you must use the greatest care to avoid accidents.

explain.short: Junctions are where paths cross and many crashes happen. Maximum care is always required there.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'massima prudenza' means 'the greatest care': this is always true at junctions.

sceneParams.caption: Junctions: maximum care

q22896.en: When approaching a junction, you must always go before the vehicles coming from the right.

explain.short: It is the opposite: as a rule you give way to vehicles coming from your right.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'sempre prima' (always before) reverses the rule: vehicles on the right normally go first.

sceneParams.caption: As a rule, the car on your right goes first

q22897.en: When approaching a junction, you must overtake quickly on the left if you want to turn right.

explain.short: Overtaking near a junction is dangerous, and to turn right you must keep close to the right edge, not move to the left.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'sorpassare velocemente a sinistra' is the wrong move: to turn right you stay on the right.

lines: Keep close to the right edge
sceneParams.caption: Turning right: stay right, don't overtake

q22898.en: When approaching a junction in built-up areas, you must sound the horn.

explain.short: In towns the horn is forbidden except in real, immediate danger. Approaching a junction is not a reason to use it.
explain.rule: Near a junction: slow down, get ready to give way, choose your lane and signal in time, and enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.trap: 'occorre suonare' says it is required: in town the horn is actually banned except for danger.

sceneParams.caption: In town: no horn at junctions

q22899.en: Near or at junctions you may not zig-zag, even if the direction lanes are marked by broken (dashed) lines.

explain.short: Weaving from lane to lane near a junction surprises other drivers. It is forbidden even when the lines are dashed.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'anche se' (even if) the lines are dashed, zig-zag is still forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: No zig-zag near junctions, even with dashed lines

q22900.en: Near or at junctions you may not change direction suddenly.

explain.short: Other drivers cannot react to a sudden change. Near a junction you choose your direction and lane in advance.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'improvvisamente' means 'suddenly': planned, signalled moves are fine, sudden ones are not.

sceneParams.caption: No sudden changes of direction at junctions

q22901.en: Near or at junctions you may not make a U-turn.

explain.short: A U-turn at a junction crosses many traffic flows at once. It is forbidden there.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' is a U-turn: banned near or at junctions.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turns at junctions

q22902.en: At junctions outside built-up areas, parking is not allowed.

explain.short: A parked vehicle at a junction hides other drivers and signs. Parking (sosta) there is forbidden.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'sosta' is parking (leaving the vehicle for a while): banned at junctions.

sceneParams.caption: No parking at junctions outside towns

q22903.en: At junctions outside built-up areas, stopping is not allowed.

explain.short: Even a short stop (fermata) at a junction blocks the view and the traffic. It is forbidden there.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'fermata' is a short stop (to let someone in or out): also banned at junctions.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping at junctions outside towns

q22904.en: Near or at junctions you may not overtake a bicycle if you have to use the opposite lane.

explain.short: At a junction you may pass a bicycle only if you stay in your half of the road. Going into the opposite lane is forbidden.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'se si deve occupare la corsia opposta' is the key: crossing to the other side makes it forbidden.

lines: You would need the other lane
sceneParams.caption: Bike at a junction: pass only without the opposite lane

q22905.en: Near or at junctions you may not use dipped headlights.

explain.short: Dipped headlights are the normal lights; you may (and often must) use them at junctions too.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'anabbaglianti' are dipped headlights, always allowed; there is no ban at junctions.

sceneParams.caption: Dipped headlights are fine at junctions

q22906.en: Near or at junctions outside built-up areas you may not go faster than 60 km/h.

explain.short: There is no special 60 km/h limit for junctions. You must adapt your speed to see and stop safely, within the road's limit.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: '60 km/h' is an invented number: the law asks for prudent speed, not a fixed figure here.

sceneParams.caption: No fixed 60 km/h limit: adapt your speed

q22907.en: At junctions in built-up areas you may turn right without using the indicator.

explain.short: You must always signal a turn with the indicator, in town too and when turning right too.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'non azionare l'indicatore' (not using the indicator) is never allowed for a turn.

sceneParams.caption: Turning right in town: indicator on

q22908.en: Near or at junctions controlled by traffic lights, overtaking is not allowed.

explain.short: At a junction with traffic lights, overtaking is allowed, because the lights decide who goes.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'regolati da semaforo' (controlled by traffic lights) is exactly the case where overtaking IS allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic-light junction: overtaking allowed

q22909.en: Near or at junctions you need not slow down if the traffic light is flashing amber.

explain.short: A flashing amber light means 'danger, go carefully': you must slow down and give way as required.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'non si deve rallentare' is wrong: flashing amber means slow down and take care.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing amber: slow down and take care

q22910.en: Near or at junctions outside built-up areas you may not use sound signals (horn).

explain.short: Outside towns the horn is allowed when needed to warn others and avoid an accident, also at junctions.
explain.rule: At junctions the danger is high: no zig-zag, no sudden turns, no U-turns, no stopping or parking (outside towns), no overtaking on the opposite lane.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' is wrong: outside towns the horn may be used when it is useful for safety.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: horn allowed when needed

q22911.en: If two vehicles arrive at a junction at the same time from different roads, as a rule the driver of the vehicle coming from the left must give way.

explain.short: The general rule is priority to the right. So the vehicle coming from the left waits.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) is correct here: signs can change it, but the basic rule is give way to the right.

lines: The one on the left waits
sceneParams.caption: Same time: the car from the left gives way

q22912.en: If two vehicles arrive at a junction at the same time from different roads, both must reduce speed to avoid accidents.

explain.short: Even the driver with priority must slow down and be careful. Both drivers share the duty of prudence.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'entrambi' (both) is right: having priority does not mean going fast.

sceneParams.caption: Both drivers slow down at the junction

q22913.en: When arriving at a junction, you must be careful and tolerant towards anyone who goes first even without having priority.

explain.short: Insisting on your priority can cause a crash. If someone wrongly goes first, let them and avoid the accident.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'tolleranti' means 'tolerant': safety comes before your right of way.

sceneParams.caption: Someone takes your priority? Let them go

q22914.en: When leaving a private property with a vehicle, you must proceed with care.

explain.short: Coming out of a gate or driveway you join traffic that has priority, often with poor view. Go carefully.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'prudenza' means care: always needed when leaving private property.

sceneParams.caption: Leaving a driveway: go carefully

q22915.en: When leaving a private property with a vehicle, you must give way to any pedestrians.

explain.short: You cross the sidewalk to reach the road, so pedestrians there go first.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'eventuali pedoni' means 'any pedestrians' who are there: they have priority.

sceneParams.caption: Leaving a driveway: pedestrians first

q22916.en: When leaving a private property with a vehicle, you must proceed slowly, especially when reversing.

explain.short: In reverse you see less, so you must go even slower when coming out of a driveway.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'specie se in retromarcia' (especially in reverse) is right: reversing out is the riskiest case.

sceneParams.caption: Reversing out of a driveway: very slowly

q22917.en: If two vehicles arrive at a junction at the same time from different roads, the driver on the narrower road must give way.

explain.short: The width of the road does not decide priority. Without signs you give way to the vehicle on your right.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'strada più stretta' (narrower road) is a fake rule: road size does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Road width doesn't matter: priority to the right

q22918.en: When leaving a private property with a vehicle, you must sound the horn.

explain.short: There is no duty to use the horn. You must go slowly and give way; the horn is only for danger.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'è obbligatorio' (it is compulsory) is the trap: the horn is never required here.

sceneParams.caption: Leaving a driveway: no horn needed

q22919.en: When leaving a private property with a vehicle, you have priority over pedestrians.

explain.short: It is the opposite: a vehicle leaving private property gives way to pedestrians.
explain.rule: Same time at a junction: give way to the vehicle on your right. Leaving private property: you give way to everyone and go slowly.
explain.trap: 'si ha la precedenza' (you have priority) is reversed: pedestrians go first.

sceneParams.caption: Leaving a driveway: pedestrians go first

q22920.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right into a narrow street, other drivers must bear in mind that it may slow down a lot.

explain.short: A long truck needs time to turn into a narrow street, so it can slow down a lot. Keep your distance.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'notevolmente' means 'a lot': expect a big drop in speed.

sceneParams.caption: Truck turning right: expect it to slow a lot

q22921.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right into a narrow street, other drivers must bear in mind that during the manoeuvre it may move to the left (swing wide).

explain.short: To turn right into a narrow street, a long truck first swings out to the left to make room for its trailer.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'si sposti a sinistra' seems strange for a right turn, but a long truck must swing left first.

lines: It swings out to the left first
Don't pass it on the right
sceneParams.caption: Truck turning right first swings left

q22922.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right into a narrow street, you must not stay too close to it, so as not to be in the way if it needs to reverse.

explain.short: The truck may not make the turn in one go and may need to back up. If you are right behind it, you block it.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'retromarcia' (reversing) is possible for a long truck: give it room behind.

sceneParams.caption: Stay back: the truck may need to reverse

q22923.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right at a junction, you must give up overtaking it, because it could block your view of signs or of vehicles coming from the side.

explain.short: A big truck hides what is beside and in front of it. Overtaking it at a junction means driving blind.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'rinunciare a sorpassarlo' means 'give up overtaking it': correct, waiting is the safe choice.

sceneParams.caption: Truck turning at a junction: don't overtake

q22924.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right into a narrow street, you must overtake it immediately on the left.

explain.short: The truck may swing left into your path. Stay behind it and wait until it has turned.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'sorpassarlo subito' (overtake it immediately) is the dangerous move: wait instead.

lines: It may swing to the left
sceneParams.caption: Truck turning right: wait, don't overtake

q22925.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right into a narrow street, the drivers behind must overtake it as soon as it switches on the indicator.

explain.short: The indicator tells you the truck is about to turn and may swing left. That is the moment to wait, not to overtake.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'appena aziona l'indicatore' (as soon as it signals) is exactly when you must NOT overtake.

sceneParams.caption: Truck signals right: stay behind

q22926.en: If a truck with trailer intends to turn right into a narrow street, the drivers behind must switch on the hazard warning lights.

explain.short: You just slow down and keep your distance. Hazard lights are for a stopped vehicle or a sudden queue, not for this.
explain.rule: A long truck turning right needs space: it slows, swings left and may reverse. Keep back and wait.
explain.trap: 'segnalazione luminosa di pericolo' means hazard lights: not required here.

sceneParams.caption: Behind a turning truck: no hazard lights needed

q22927.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road must give way to oncoming vehicles.

explain.short: During a U-turn you cross both lanes, so every vehicle coming has priority over you.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'sopraggiungono' means vehicles arriving from either direction: all of them go first.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn: give way to all vehicles coming

q22928.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road must give up the manoeuvre if traffic is heavy and continuous.

explain.short: With heavy traffic there is no safe gap for a slow manoeuvre across the road. Give up and find another way.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'rinunciare' means 'give up': with heavy traffic that is the right choice.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy traffic: give up the U-turn

q22929.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road must give up the manoeuvre if visibility is poor.

explain.short: If you cannot see far, a car may arrive while you block the road. Do not make the U-turn.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'scarsa visibilità' (poor visibility) always forbids a U-turn.

lines: Two-way road: fog or poor view
sceneParams.caption: Poor visibility: no U-turn

q22930.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road must use the indicator.

explain.short: A U-turn is a change of direction, so you must signal it with the indicator (usually left).
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'indicatore di direzione' is the indicator: required for every change of direction, U-turn included.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn: indicator on

q22931.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road must not create danger or obstruction for other road users.

explain.short: A U-turn is allowed only if nobody has to brake or swerve because of you.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'pericolo o intralcio' (danger or obstruction): you must cause neither.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn only without danger or obstruction

q22932.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road must switch on the hazard warning lights.

explain.short: The right signal for a U-turn is the direction indicator, not the hazard lights.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'segnalazione luminosa di pericolo' are hazard lights: wrong signal for a U-turn.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn: indicator, not hazard lights

q22933.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road may also do it on a bend, if he gives way to all vehicles.

explain.short: On a bend nobody can see you in time, so a U-turn there is forbidden, even if you give way.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'anche in curva' (even on a bend): giving way does not make a U-turn on a bend allowed.

lines: Cars can't see you in time
sceneParams.caption: No U-turn on a bend, even giving way

q22934.en: A driver who is allowed to make a U-turn on a two-way road must check whether the centre line is solid.

explain.short: The quiz lists the duties of a U-turn as: indicator, give way, no danger, enough visibility. Checking the centre line is not on that list, and this driver 'can' already make the U-turn.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'può effettuare' (is allowed to make) means the U-turn is already allowed, so this extra duty is not part of the rule.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn duties: indicator, give way, no danger

q22934.reviewNote: Odd official FALSE: crossing a solid centre line for a U-turn is forbidden; explained via 'può' (U-turn already allowed).

q22935.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road may do it even with poor visibility, if the centre line is dashed.

explain.short: A dashed line does not make a U-turn safe. With poor visibility it is always forbidden.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'anche con scarsa visibilità' (even with poor visibility): the dashed line does not change that.

sceneParams.caption: Poor visibility: no U-turn, dashed line or not

q22936.en: A driver who wants to make a U-turn on a two-way road may do it only on wide roads that allow it in a single manoeuvre.

explain.short: You may use several back-and-forth manoeuvres on a narrower road, as long as it is safe and allowed.
explain.rule: A U-turn is allowed only when it is safe: indicator on, give way to everyone, good visibility, light traffic.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) and 'una sola manovra' (one single manoeuvre) are the trap: more manoeuvres are fine.

sceneParams.caption: U-turn may take several manoeuvres

q22937.en: On two-way roads you may not make a U-turn near or on bends.

explain.short: On a bend oncoming drivers cannot see you in time. U-turns there are forbidden.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'curve' means bends: a classic place where U-turns are banned.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn near bends

q22938.en: A U-turn is not allowed near or at junctions.

explain.short: At a junction many vehicles cross. A U-turn there would confuse and endanger them.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'incroci' means junctions: U-turns are banned near or at them.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn near junctions

q22939.en: On two-way roads you may not make a U-turn in any case of poor visibility.

explain.short: Whatever the cause (fog, rain, night, a bend), if you can't see far, a U-turn is forbidden.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'in tutti i casi' (in all cases) is correct here: poor visibility always forbids it.

sceneParams.caption: Poor visibility: never a U-turn

q22940.en: On two-way roads you may not make a U-turn near or on hilltops.

explain.short: At the top of a hill (dosso) you cannot see cars coming from the other side. U-turns are forbidden there.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'dossi' are hilltops / humps that hide the road behind them.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn near hilltops

q22941.en: When there are no road markings, U-turns are not allowed.

explain.short: Missing paint on the road does not forbid a U-turn. What matters is visibility, bends, hilltops, junctions and traffic.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'manca la segnaletica orizzontale' (no road markings) is not a reason to ban a U-turn.

sceneParams.caption: No markings doesn't ban a U-turn

q22942.en: If the edge line of the carriageway is solid, U-turns are not allowed.

explain.short: The edge line (linea di margine) marks the side of the road, not the middle. It does not forbid a U-turn.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'linea di margine' is the EDGE line, not the centre line (mezzeria).

lines: Solid line at the road edge
It is not the centre line
sceneParams.caption: Solid edge line doesn't ban a U-turn

q22943.en: Outside built-up areas you may not make a U-turn.

explain.short: U-turns are allowed outside towns too, if there is no bend, hilltop, junction or poor visibility, and it is safe.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'Fuori dai centri abitati' (outside towns) is not a ban by itself.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns U-turns are allowed if safe

q22944.en: On motorways with three lanes in each direction, U-turns are allowed.

explain.short: On motorways U-turns are always forbidden, however many lanes there are.
explain.rule: No U-turns near bends, hilltops, junctions, with poor visibility or on motorways.
explain.trap: 'tre corsie' (three lanes) changes nothing: no U-turns on any motorway.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway: U-turns always forbidden

q22945.en: When arriving at a junction with a roundabout, you must give way to vehicles coming from the left only if there is a GIVE WAY sign.

explain.short: Giving way to the cars already on the roundabout (from your left) is required by the DARE PRECEDENZA sign. Without it, the general rule applies.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) is right: the duty to yield to the left comes from the sign.

lines: Give way to cars on the ring
sceneParams.caption: Roundabout with give way sign: yield to the left

q22946.en: At junctions with a roundabout, if there is no specific sign, the general rule of giving way to the right applies.

explain.short: A roundabout without signs is a normal junction: you give way to vehicles on your right.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'in assenza di specifico segnale' (with no specific sign): then the normal priority to the right applies.

sceneParams.caption: Roundabout with no sign: give way to the right

q22947.en: At junctions with a roundabout, traffic can be organised so that vehicles entering give way to those already on the ring.

explain.short: Usually signs at the entrance tell you to give way to the cars already going round. This is allowed and very common.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'può essere disciplinata' (can be organised) is right: it is possible, with signs.

sceneParams.caption: Entering a roundabout: often yield to the ring

q22948.en: At a junction with a roundabout, the duty to give way can be imposed on vehicles about to enter.

explain.short: With a DARE PRECEDENZA sign at the entrance, entering vehicles must give way to the ring.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'può essere imposto' (can be imposed) is right: signs can impose it.

sceneParams.caption: Signs can make entering cars give way

q22949.en: When arriving at a junction with a roundabout, before entering it is advisable to reduce speed and take the greatest care, watching what other road users are doing.

explain.short: Entering a roundabout needs a slow approach and a good look at the cars going round and the pedestrians.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'moderare la velocità' (reduce speed) and 'massima prudenza' (greatest care) are both correct.

sceneParams.caption: Before the roundabout: slow down and look

q22950.en: If on a steep road vehicles cannot easily pass each other, as a rule the driver going downhill must stop and, if needed, reverse.

explain.short: Starting again uphill is harder, so the driver going down stops and, if needed, backs up.
explain.rule: On a steep narrow road the driver going downhill gives way, because restarting uphill is harder.
explain.trap: 'in discesa' (downhill) is right: the downhill driver gives way.

sceneParams.caption: Steep narrow road: the downhill car gives way

q22951.en: With a GIVE WAY sign, if you need to stop, you must do so at the transverse line made of a row of white triangles.

explain.short: The give way line is a row of white triangles across your lane. If you must stop, stop there.
explain.rule: DARE PRECEDENZA (give way): slow down, stop only if needed, and if you stop, do it at the line of white triangles.
explain.trap: 'triangoli bianchi' (white triangles) form the give way line: that is where you stop.

sceneParams.caption: Give way: stop at the line of triangles

q22952.en: When arriving at a junction with a roundabout, it is compulsory to give way to vehicles coming from the left.

explain.short: It is compulsory only if a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so. Without a sign, you give way to the right.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'è obbligatorio' (it is compulsory) without mentioning the sign is too strong.

lines: Yield left only with a sign
sceneParams.caption: Yield to the left only with a sign

q22953.en: To enter a junction with a roundabout, you must always give way to vehicles already going round inside it.

explain.short: Not always: only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign is there. Without a sign, priority to the right applies.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is the trap: it depends on the sign.

lines: Yield to the ring only with a sign
sceneParams.caption: Not always: only when the sign says so

q22954.en: At a junction with a roundabout, vehicles going round the ring may reverse.

explain.short: Reversing in a roundabout goes against the flow and is very dangerous. If you miss your exit, go round again.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'retromarcia' (reversing) is never allowed in the ring.

sceneParams.caption: Missed your exit? Go round again, never reverse

q22956.en: When a junction has a roundabout, vehicles going round the ring may overtake on both the right and the left.

explain.short: Inside the ring you overtake on the left only, like everywhere. Passing on the right is not allowed.
explain.rule: Roundabout: give way to the ring only when a DARE PRECEDENZA sign says so; with no sign, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'sia a destra che a sinistra' (both right and left) is the trap: only on the left.

sceneParams.caption: In the ring overtake on the left only

keywords.it: sia a destra che a sinistra

q22957.en: If on a steep road vehicles cannot easily pass each other, as a rule the driver going downhill must stop and, if needed, reverse.

explain.short: Starting again uphill is harder, so the driver going down stops and, if needed, backs up.
explain.rule: Steep narrow road: downhill driver gives way (unless the other is at a passing bay). STOP sign: always stop.
explain.trap: 'in discesa' (downhill) is right: the downhill driver gives way.

sceneParams.caption: Steep narrow road: the downhill car gives way

q22958.en: If on a steep road passing between vehicles is difficult, and one of the two drivers is near a passing bay, that driver must pull over and let the other pass.

explain.short: A passing bay (piazzola di scambio) is made for this. Whoever is closest to it, uphill or downhill, pulls in.
explain.rule: Steep narrow road: downhill driver gives way (unless the other is at a passing bay). STOP sign: always stop.
explain.trap: 'piazzola di scambio' (passing bay) changes the normal rule: the driver next to it gives way.

lines: You are next to a passing bay
Pull in and let them pass
sceneParams.caption: Near a passing bay? You pull in

q22959.en: With a GIVE WAY sign you must be careful and reduce speed, but you need to stop only if necessary.

explain.short: Give way means slow down and let others pass. You stop only if a vehicle is coming; otherwise you continue.
explain.rule: DARE PRECEDENZA (give way): slow down and stop only if needed. STOP: you must always stop completely.
explain.trap: 'solo in caso di necessità' (only if necessary) is the difference from STOP, where you always stop.

lines: Stop only if a car comes
sceneParams.caption: Give way: stop only if needed

q22960.en: With a STOP sign you need not stop if there is no stop line and no vehicles can be seen coming.

explain.short: At a STOP sign you must always stop completely, with or without a line, even if the road looks empty.
explain.rule: DARE PRECEDENZA (give way): slow down and stop only if needed. STOP: you must always stop completely.
explain.trap: 'non occorre arrestarsi' is the trap: at STOP you always stop.

sceneParams.caption: STOP: always a full stop

q22961.en: If on a steep road vehicles cannot easily pass each other, as a rule the driver going uphill must stop.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the driver going DOWNHILL stops, because restarting uphill is harder.
explain.rule: Steep narrow road: downhill driver gives way (unless the other is at a passing bay). STOP sign: always stop.
explain.trap: 'in salita' (uphill) is swapped with 'in discesa' (downhill).

sceneParams.caption: Steep road: the downhill car stops, not uphill

q22962.en: Near a junction with traffic lights, you may stop on the pedestrian crossing if the pedestrian light is red.

explain.short: You must never stop on a pedestrian crossing. Stop before the stop line or wait before the junction.
explain.rule: Never stop on a pedestrian crossing: wait before the stop line or before the junction.
explain.trap: 'consentito arrestarsi sulle strisce' is never true, whatever colour the pedestrian light shows.

sceneParams.caption: Never stop on a pedestrian crossing
